newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Entertainment names Wolfinger CFO.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Entertainment names Wolfinger CFO.

text.p: Hollywood Entertainment Corp said it hired Mark Wolfinger as its chief financial officer.
The company did not say when the appointment would be effective or who he replaced. It did not provide further details, and officials there were not immediately available to comment.
Wolfinger joined Hollywood Entertainment from Metromedia Restaurant Group, Hollywood said.
Hollywood Entertainment is the parent of Hollywood Video, the second-largest video store chain in the U.S.
